properties.Caption: VAT Product Posting Groups
properties.AboutText: Define VAT product posting groups to control how VAT is calculated and posted for different items and resources, using codes that specify applicable VAT rates for purchases and sales.

procedures.name: UpdateForm
procedures.doc: Updates the VAT statement preview with new calculation parameters and filters. Refreshes display with updated selection criteria and currency preferences.

procedures.name: UpdateForm
procedures.doc: Updates the VAT statement preview with new calculation parameters including country/region filtering. Extended version providing geographic filtering capability for multi-country VAT reporting scenarios.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCalcColumnValue
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before calculating column values for VAT statement line preview. Enables custom calculation logic and override of standard amount calculations.

procedures.name: OnBeforeOpenPageVATEntryTotaling
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before opening VAT entry page for VAT entry totaling drill-down. Enables custom filtering and modification of VAT entry records before page display.

procedures.name: OnColumnValueDrillDownOnBeforeRunGeneralLedgerEntries
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before running G/L entries page during column value drill-down. Enables custom filtering and modification of G/L entry records before page display.

procedures.name: OnUpdateFormOnBeforePageUpdate
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before updating the page during form update process. Enables custom modifications to VAT statement configuration before page refresh.

procedures.name: OnAfterUpdateForm
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after completing the form update process. Enables custom post-processing after VAT statement preview has been refreshed.
